title: Ocolet909's Modpack
description: A mod for me and my friends, first time here. The mod contains food mods such as farmers delight, some weapon mods that add realistic rifles, 1 mod that adds simple tiers, and alot of performance mods to keep it running on school laptops.
body: Hello yall, this is my first modpack. I honestly thought it would be a lot easier to create this, but anyway, this is what this modpack is all about. I've made this to use on a new server with my friends. Usually someone else with way more experience makes the server and modpack. But me and my best friend wanted our own mods, since we mostly like the same things, and because we wanted some impactful mods that not everyone from our MC group liked. This modpack contains 5 major themes; guns and rifles, tiered gear, food, building and most important optimization. Maybe i will add some bigger mods in the future to explore, but i didn't since i play on a cheap school laptop. Everyone should be able to run this; with my laptop that lags in Word(!), i get around 20 FPS.
